title: Activate a Lightning Experience theme
when: The step makes one named theme the active Lightning Experience theme for the org, on the Themes and Branding page. It is not creating or editing a theme, and not changing a user's personal settings.
steps: On the Themes and Branding page, find the row for the theme the step names.
Open that row's action menu (the arrow at the end of the row) and click 'Activate'. Use only that row's menu.
doneWhen: The named theme's row shows it as the active theme.

verified.outcome: Trial step matched at p=1.00; 4 actions, 31 s, reviewer confirmed; a fresh session showed Lightning Lite with Active = True. A pure Lightning page with per-row action menus. Salesforce left no Setup Audit Trail entry for it, so that fresh-session read is the evidence.

trial.step: Activate the built-in Lightning Lite theme for the org.

notes: Browserforce covers this as lightning-experience-settings (activeThemeName). A pure Lightning page with per-row action menus.
